definitions.explanation: not mixed with anything else; consisting of only one element
free from deceit or guile; sincere

notes:
{純粋|じゅんすい} is a na-adjective with two main uses: physical purity (unmixed, unadulterated) and personal innocence or sincerity.

FORMS:
- {純粋|じゅんすい}な: pure (attributive)
- {純粋|じゅんすい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: purely (adverbial)
- {純粋|じゅんすい}さ: purity (noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {純粋|じゅんすい}な{気持|きも}ち: pure feelings
- {純粋|じゅんすい}な⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧: pure heart
- {純粋|じゅんすい}{培養|ばいよう}: pure culture (scientific)
- {純粋|じゅんすい}⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧: pure mathematics
- {純粋|じゅんすい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: enjoy purely, simply enjoy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{単純|たんじゅん}→単純：03414_tanjun⟧: simple (shares ⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧ but means uncomplicated, not 'pure')
- ⟦{素朴|そぼく}→素朴：06071_soboku⟧: simple, naive, unsophisticated
- ⟦{無垢|むく}→無垢：13421_muku⟧: pure, innocent (literary/poetic)
